summary: No, in four languages and three codebooks each: the fall in character entropy under a reversible 2-symbol expansion is an artefact of counting per output character (per source character H2 rises, e.g. Latin 3.36 to 4.56-4.66 bits), and padding with a null lowers per-character H2 further than the verbose code, so the fall is not specific to encipherment.
